event: Identify the location of a ticking sound relative to a virtual robot standing by the black round ottoman and facing the gray reclining lounge chair with ottoman.

sounding_object.description: A stainless steel gas stovetop with multiple black grates and black knobs, integrated into a white countertop with wooden cabinetry. The specific sounding part is one of the gas burners which makes a repetitive clicking/ticking sound when being ignited.

reference_object.description: A medium-sized, round ottoman, upholstered in a dark, possibly black or very dark gray, textured fabric. It appears to be about 0.5 meters in diameter and 0.4 meters high.

facing_object.object_name: Gray reclining lounge chair with ottoman
facing_object.description: A light gray fabric reclining lounge chair with a wide seat and back, and a separate matching rectangular ottoman. The chair has a modern design.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the black round ottoman and facing the gray reclining lounge chair with ottoman, when the ticking sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: left, right, or back? If the object is generally to your left and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees left, choose 'left'. If the object is generally to your right and facing it requires turning less than 120 degrees right, choose 'right'. If the object is generally behind you and facing it requires turning 120 degrees or more, choose 'back'.
